_predeclaration_note: run5 (2026-09-09, fifth real-data cycle, PROP-NATIVE-01/02 -- ~/ANSE.ASIA/toledo/registry/proposals/native_retained_sensitivity.json, H3). This file, split_manifest.json, RATIONALE.md, and native_threshold_derivation.json are committed in their OWN commit, BEFORE lab/run_native_sensitivity.py is invoked against test.jsonl for run5. This is a GENUINELY DIFFERENT decision mechanism from runs 1-4 (lab/native_sensitivity.py): no fitted error-shape model, no calibrated completion set, no conformal quantile, and no comparison against a task tolerance via a predicted/derived error bound. ACT is licensed only if cqts.safety.fail_closed_task_pass gives the SAME verdict for T_hat_k and T_hat_k perturbed along H_k's own single smallest eigenvalue direction (both signs), by a magnitude m=min(C/lambda_min, CAP). lambda_ref (median TRAIN lambda_min) and cap (p75 TRAIN local-dispersion-proxy Euclidean norm) are both derived from TRAIN-split data only -- see RATIONALE.md and native_threshold_derivation.json for the full method and the honest record of an earlier candidate cap that was found (via CALIBRATION-only diagnostics, never test) to make the invariance test structurally vacuous. No calibration/test statistic was inspected before this commit. Dataset/split/ICP backend/task tolerances/error_floor/alpha/inference are all reused BYTE-IDENTICAL from run2/run3/run4 -- only the decision mechanism varies. Data files (lab/data/bop_lmo_episodes_native/{train,calibration,test}.jsonl) are regenerated from the SAME frames/seeds/ICP as run1-4 (confirmed byte-identical split_manifest.json splits), with 'features'/'incremental_ms'/'estimator_stop' unchanged and one added 'native' field per stage (H_k flattened + T_hat_k) replacing run4's 'decay' field; the original run1-4 data files and code paths are untouched and remain independently reproducible.

backend.name: in-repo numpy+scipy point-to-point ICP/Kabsch (lab/bop_icp_backend.py)
backend.model_weights: none (no learned model; closed-form SVD/Kabsch rigid-transform update each iteration)
backend.note: Backend gains one additive per-stage export (lab/adapter_bop.py:export_episode_native, native_sensitivity_stage_fields) exposing H_k and T_hat_k=(R_k,t_k); the Kabsch closed-form update itself is unchanged (same as run4). This run5 config/freeze commit is built on top of the theory/CONTINUUM_AUDIT_20260909.md commit (parent of this file's own commit).

dataset.name: BOP LineMOD-Occlusion (LM-O) test_bop19 subset, scene 000002
dataset.frame_prefilter: frames dropped from the sampling pool if either object has fewer than 300 mask_visib pixels with a nonzero real depth reading (real sensor dropout / heavy occlusion), applied before any random draw
dataset.frame_draw: 60 frames drawn without replacement from the prefiltered pool, numpy Generator seed 20260909
dataset.frame_split: 60 drawn frames permuted (numpy Generator seed 20260909) and cut 20/20/20 into TRAIN/CALIBRATION/FINAL TEST; all episodes (both objects) from one frame land in exactly one split
dataset.independent_sampling_unit: frame (not object-episode): the true number of independent draws is 60 frames, split 20/20/20; the two per-frame object episodes share the same depth-noise realization and are therefore not treated as independent units by the split rule
dataset.object_segmentation: dataset-provided ground-truth mask_visib for the target object in each frame; no online detector/segmentation network is executed -- this experiment tests the REFINEMENT stage only, not detection/segmentation
dataset.initial_pose: documented bounded random perturbation of real ground truth (lab/bop_icp_backend.py:perturb_pose): translation += isotropic Gaussian noise sigma=15mm per axis; rotation = random-axis rotation with angle ~ Uniform[5,20] degrees composed with ground-truth rotation. This simulates a coarse detector stage; it is not a full autonomous detection pipeline.
dataset.ground_truth_orthonormalization: BOP cam_R_m2c matrices are not exactly orthonormal at float precision (observed residual up to ~3e-4); both ground-truth and estimated rotations are projected to the nearest proper rotation via SVD (lab/bop_icp_backend.py:orthonormalize) before oracle error computation, applied identically to both.

estimator_side_stopping_rule: two consecutive ICP stages with |delta_t| <= 0.5mm and |delta_r| <= 0.1deg (lab/bop_icp_backend.py:estimator_converged); if never satisfied within the 15-iteration budget, lab/run_real_system.py's estimator_index() falls back to the terminal stage
timing_mode_reason: incremental_ms is real measured per-iteration wall-clock (cKDTree query + Kabsch SVD), but no separate online_policy_measured dual-policy execution was run; a latency-reduction PASS is therefore deliberately disabled by this timing_mode, matching lab/README.md section 5/7
inference_caveat: minimum_test_episodes=30 and independent_sampling_unit=episode are reused unchanged from lab/config.example.json's evaluator field, which the public evaluator (lab/run_real_system.py) treats as one unit per JSONL row (40 test rows satisfy minimum_test_episodes=30). This is a WEAKER independence assumption than dataset.independent_sampling_unit=frame above (only 20 independent test frames), because the evaluator has no native concept of frame-level clustering; the discrepancy is reported explicitly rather than silently reconciled, and the true independent count for power purposes is 20 frames, not 40 episodes.
tasks_reused_note: task reader kind/mask unchanged from lab/config.example.json and from run 1's config.json; only the numeric per-component tolerance was replaced with a value derived from TRAIN-split achievable ICP accuracy (75th percentile of the estimator-convergence-stage absolute pose error across the 40 TRAIN episodes, rounded up to 1mm / 1deg grid -- see TOLERANCE_DECISION.md). Components a task's mask does not use keep the original 1e9 sentinel unchanged.

native_sensitivity.decision_mechanism: PROP-NATIVE-01/02: ACT iff fail_closed_task_pass invariant across {baseline(zero self-deviation), +perturbed, -perturbed} along H_k's single smallest eigenvalue direction
native_sensitivity.eigenpair_source: lab/decay_predictor.py:eigh_H (additive to run4's kappa_rho_from_H, same symmetrization/eigh routine family, not a separately re-derived decomposition)
native_sensitivity.eigenvalue_selection_rule: exactly the single smallest eigenvalue of H_k and its eigenvector (predeclared; the simpler of the two options the handoff offered over 'all eigenvalues below a declared fraction of lambda_max')
native_sensitivity.perturbation_magnitude_formula: m = min(C / lambda_min, CAP), C = CAP * lambda_ref
native_sensitivity.lambda_ref_method: median(lambda_min(H_k)) over all 640 TRAIN stage readings (lab/derive_native_threshold_from_train.py)
native_sensitivity.cap_method: 75th percentile of the Euclidean norm of the online-observable local-dispersion proxy (lab/bop_icp_backend.py:local_proxy, the same 6-component proxy already used in observable_features) over all 640 TRAIN stage readings -- a physically-grounded scale (a real observed per-stage residual-uncertainty statistic), not an arbitrary round number. See RATIONALE.md for the discarded earlier candidate cap (0.005, a hand-picked round number below every task tolerance) that CALIBRATION-only diagnostics showed made the test structurally vacuous, and why this TRAIN-derived alternative was adopted instead.
native_sensitivity.fail_closed_degenerate_rule: if lambda_min is non-finite or <= 0 (H_k numerically singular), m is set to CAP (bounded, never unbounded, never silently zero)
native_sensitivity.ground_truth_use: NONE in the online decision; oracle abs_pose_error_6d is used only afterward by the evaluator to score ACT-licensed and HOLD episodes, exactly the same offline role T* already plays for runs 1-4
known_limitations: SE(3) is still a continuum manifold representation for T_hat_k (theory/CONTINUUM_AUDIT_20260909.md item 1) -- this cycle removes T* from the online decision but does not fix that deeper continuum injection

a single H_k eigenvector mixes 3 rotation (radians) and 3 translation (metres) components, perturbed by one shared scalar magnitude without separate nondimensionalization -- the same honesty gap already disclosed for kappa in docs/NAVIER_STOKES_THROUGH_OUR_LENS.md

no proven floor exists yet for 'how small a lambda_min is too small' (q_formal/M.07's diameter-based floor was already shown in run4 not to apply to H_k's own structure, and remains unmechanized regardless); CAP is a declared/relative TRAIN-derived bound, not a bound resting on any proven floor

the relationship between 'H_k has a small eigenvalue' and 'the true pose error along that direction is large' is itself an assumption per PROP-NATIVE-02's own honest_caveats -- this run is exactly the empirical check that assumption needed
